description:
[marketsummary] Ask a market question in natural language; the answer is written only from Tachyo's recap items.

 question: plain text, at most 500 characters (longer returns error "question too long").
 lang: en / pl (anything else is answered in en). The answer draws on up to 40 recap/digest items
 from the last 7 days, ranked by overlap with the question's words (the most recent items when
 nothing overlaps). It has no on-chain wallet lookups and never covers anyone's positions or our
 own track record. `as_of` is the timestamp of the newest item used. Free returns a connect-CTA.
 Unlock a grounded answer via session_token (from verify_wallet_ownership) OR an x402 `payment`
 proof. When synthesis is unavailable, `answer` is null, `relevant` lists the top headlines and
 the call is not charged.
name: marketsummary__ask_market
